Tubing connection (thread) leak
nodes.physics: Seal of a premium connection opens a micro-path between tubing and A-annulus.

nodes.name: Tubing corrosion pit / hole (growing)
nodes.physics: CO2 / H2S corrosion penetrates the wall; the hole grows with time.

nodes.name: Tubing wall loss (pressure-capacity loss)
nodes.physics: General wall thinning lowers burst and, more strongly, collapse capacity.

nodes.name: Packer element degradation
nodes.physics: Elastomer ageing, chemical attack, decompression or extrusion lets the element leak.

nodes.name: Packer movement / unseating
nodes.physics: Tubing thermal and ballooning forces move or unseat the packer (same leak path as element leak; simulated with the same leak model).

nodes.name: DHSV leakage in closed position
nodes.physics: Erosion, scale or debris on flapper and seat let fluid pass when closed.

nodes.name: DHSV fail to close on demand
nodes.physics: Scale, debris, wax or a damaged flow tube keep the valve open.

nodes.name: Control-line leak / communication
nodes.physics: Loss of hydraulic pressure (valve fails closed) or tubing fluid entering the line.

nodes.name: Tubing-hanger seal leak
nodes.physics: Hanger seals degrade; tubing-head pressure reaches the top of the A-annulus.

nodes.name: A-annulus outlet / valve seal leak to environment
nodes.physics: Valve stem, bonnet or flange seal on the A outlet leaks to atmosphere.

nodes.name: Casing-hanger pack-off leak
nodes.physics: Pack-off between production casing and casing-head spool leaks: A and B communicate at surface.

nodes.name: B-annulus outlet / valve seal leak to environment
nodes.physics: Valve or flange seal on the B outlet leaks to atmosphere.

nodes.name: Master valve internal leakage
nodes.physics: Gate and seat wear or debris; leaks when closed.

nodes.name: Master valve fail to close
nodes.physics: Actuator, stem or gate fault prevents closure on demand.

nodes.name: Wing valve internal leakage
nodes.physics: Gate and seat wear; leaks when closed.

nodes.name: Choke trim erosion
nodes.physics: Sand and droplets erode the trim; effective opening grows ~ velocity^2.

nodes.name: Production-casing leak (hole / connection)
nodes.physics: Hole or leaking connection in the production casing above the top of cement.

nodes.name: Production-casing wear / corrosion (capacity loss)
nodes.physics: Drill-string wear and corrosion thin the wall: burst ~ t, collapse ~ t^2.

nodes.name: Cement micro-annulus / channel gas migration
nodes.physics: Debonding or channels let shallow-zone gas migrate into the B-annulus.

nodes.name: Intermediate-casing wear / corrosion (capacity loss)
nodes.physics: Wall loss lowers the burst capacity that limits B-annulus pressure.

nodes.name: Intermediate-casing leak to formation
nodes.physics: Hole in the intermediate casing: B-annulus communicates with an open formation.
